title: Fabric authority boundaries
summary: Queue Fabric owns durable queue/channel and delivery receipts; Storage Fabric owns pinned input and output commits; Memory Fabric owns resident generation and epoch. XTP owns carrier/context transport only.
invariants: Network packet ACK != Queue Fabric delivery commit != RTO2 committed result != Storage durable output.
Service-first XTP work must not silently downgrade to another transport when service admission is denied.
Memory transfers require generation/epoch fencing and receiver authorisation.
Customer-video execution and Job-to-Node/Migratable Job leases remain separate live qualification milestones.
Do not introduce a second queue, storage or placement authority in the Grid adapter.

provenance.claim: Scope explicitly limited to RTO2 local smoke rather than full fabrics
